captions.detailed: A minimalist, matte grey bicycle crankset assembly consisting of a cylindrical bottom bracket shell housing a central spindle. It features a right crank arm with an integrated single-speed chainring, a left crank arm oriented 180 degrees opposite, and two rectangular pedal blocks. Mechanically, the spindle, both crank arms, and the chainring rotate continuously as a single rigid system relative to the fixed bottom bracket, while each pedal rotates independently on its respective spindle axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a bicycle crankset with a central bottom bracket shell, a rotating spindle, left and right crank arms, a single-speed chainring on the right side, and two rectangular pedals. Ensure continuous rotational joints are modeled for the main spindle assembly and for each pedal.
captions.factory: Construct a fixed central cylindrical bottom bracket shell. Create a rotating spindle part that passes through the bottom bracket. Model the right crank arm with a circular chainring containing outer teeth, and model the left crank arm opposite to it. Attach each arm to the spindle, and add rectangular pedal blocks mounted on cylindrical axles at the ends of the crank arms using continuous rotational joints.
